identityClarification: Exactly TWO equipment assemblies from original reference 1. LEFT / CENTER: one very compact short warm BRASS CANNON on a little brown wooden cradle/carriage. Its broad hollow muzzle faces LEFT and a little toward viewer, its barrel rises to upper-right, with a few large raised rings and one dark trunnion. The blocky wooden cradle below has EXACTLY TWO visible large round wooden spoked wheels: one lower-left and one lower-right, the right wheel with a dark iron tire. Preserve this original miniature equipment silhouette without adding a crew or chassis extension. LOWER RIGHT: ONE separate wooden scoop, bowl full of a small clustered handful of dark round shot/pellets, and a short handle projecting upper-right. Simplify the tiny shot texture into a few clear chunky dark rounded forms; keep the filled scoop's functional meaning. No sparks, flame, smoke, fuse, explosion, emblem, crew, horse or scenery.
